note: Kaiju alert signs (task T-130). Move, add or remove entries freely; no code change. block is [column, row] in the 4 x 4 grid from the north-west (the gravel centre has none). kind banner hangs on a skyscraper's visible wall of slot [si, sj] in its block (wall y = the +y face, wall x = the +x face; along = units from the wall's left end on screen, 0 to 9; bottom_units = height of its bottom above the ground). kind sign stands on the pavement at the block's +x/+y corner, inset units in from the kerb. design: head (red triangle) or body (red circle).
